name: Content Patcher pack (no code)
summary: A Stardew Valley content pack: change items, dialogue, images and maps with JSON, no programming.
description: A folder with a manifest.json and a content.json that the Content Patcher mod reads. Nothing to build: the folder itself is the mod and goes into the game's Mods folder. Needs SMAPI and Content Patcher installed in the game.

options.label: Mod name
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only

options.label: Author
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only
options.help: Goes into the pack's UniqueID, which must never change once people use the mod.

options.label: Description
options.default: One or two sentences about the mod.
options.help: Shown in the SMAPI console and on mod sites.

options.label: Game folder
options.help: The folder with Stardew Valley.exe. Only used to write the exact install path into the README.

options.label: Player settings
options.help: A ConfigSchema with an on/off setting, saved as config.json and shown in Generic Mod Config Menu.

options.label: Translations
options.help: An i18n folder with default.json, used through the i18n token.

options.label: Content Patcher format version
options.help: The Content Patcher version the pack is written for. Players need that version or newer.

next: Install SMAPI and Content Patcher into Stardew Valley first if they are not there yet.
Put the whole [CP] {{ModName}} folder into the game's Mods folder. There is nothing to build.
Start the game through SMAPI and look for the pack under Content Patcher in the SMAPI console.
Load a save and look at a parsnip: its description is the one from this pack.
Your changes go into content.json, in the Changes list.
